none: PAS SWYOR-23F346: Roman coin; nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy Roman coin, probably a nummus of the House of Constantine, dating from AD 318 - 320 (Reece Period 16), probably VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP reverse type showing two Victories holding a wreath between them inscribed VOT / P R. The coin is broken with only about two thirds surviving
